summary: We developed a simple 2D videogame about resource management in space missions. You appear in a laboratory, and by upon interacting with the main console, you can select a total of 6 missions (tutorial + 5 different missions). You need to select different pieces to build a spaceship for the mission. Depending on the requeriments for the mission, you have to select different pieces, managing resources such as budget, mass, energy and data.
details:
The game "Space Mission Simulator" was developed using the engine RPG Maker MZ. The proposal was to create a resource management game applied to space missions. You interact with the main console to select among a total of 6 missions (tutorial + 5), and according to the mission requeriments, you have to select different spaceship pieces, managing resources such as budget, mass, energy and data transmission.

Other than the own software, the graphics utilized were mostly the default graphics of the software, some extra graphics from the community (free to use), and art created specifically for the game, such as the cover artwork and a few of the pieces to select, plus editing.

For the data gathering and number balances, AI was used, to make sure that the numeric values for every piece make sense and is balanced. By numeric values, it means for example the cost, energy usage or weight of the different pieces. The numeric values were also managed in Excel.

The music is an original composition, although not composed specifically for this project.
